forms.title: Belarus e-visa issuance (service 3.04.01) — e-pasluga.by
forms.stoppedAt: The application form is available only in a personal account on the portal (registration by email, phone, Google or Apple)

steps.name: Service description
notices: The e-visa application has to be submitted at least seven calendar days before the requested date of entry into Belarus.
The decision on the e-visa application is sent to your personal account on this website.
The electronic visa must be printed out and carried with you when entering/leaving and during your stay in Belarus.
The information provided in the electronic application form must be complete and accurate. Inaccurate information may result in refusal of entry to Belarus.

steps.name: How to get the service
notices: No strong authentication (access via the Consumer's login). To access the service, you need to: 1. Register using your email, mobile phone number, or Google/Apple accounts; 2. Authenticate on the portal. The service will be available in your personal account.

steps.name: Service cost
notices: The cost of the service consists of: A service fee: 6 euros (charged to each applicant, regardless of age or citizenship). A consular fee: 35 euros – for citizens of Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, as well as stateless persons residing in Estonia, and non-citizens of Latvia; 60 euros – for citizens of other states; 0 euro (free of charge) – for citizens of Japan; 0 euro (free of charge) – for citizens of Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden under the age of twelve; 0 euro (free of charge) – for citizens of other states, non-citizens of Latvia and stateless persons permanently residing in Estonia under the age of fourteen. All fees are included in the total amount, which is paid once when submitting the visa application

steps.name: Categories of service recipients
notices: Individuals - non-residents of the Republic of Belarus according to the list of states whose citizens can obtain an electronic visa

steps.name: Service result
notices: An electronic message in your personal account on this website: a notification of the issuance of the electronic visa and a PDF file of the electronic visa, or a notification of the refusal to issue the electronic visa
